text: Buenas tardes, quería consultarle algo. Ayer cené pollo recalentado y quedé intoxicado: vomité toda la noche. Tengo alergia a las sulfas. Uso ibuprofeno de 400 miligramos cuando lo necesito.

intake.summary_en: The patient reports food poisoning and vomiting all night starting yesterday after eating reheated chicken. They report a sulfa allergy and use 400 mg of ibuprofen as needed.

response.read: Buenas tardes, quería consultarle algo. Ayer cené pollo recalentado y quedé intoxicado: vomité toda la noche. Tengo alergia a las sulfas. Uso ibuprofeno de 400 miligramos cuando lo necesito.

word_alerts.note: Spanish 'intoxicado/a' means poisoned or made sick by something taken in (food, a chemical, a medicine, alcohol). It does not by itself mean drunk or high. Decide from context: after food -> food_poisoning; after alcohol -> alcohol_intoxication; after pills or drugs -> drug_overdose. If the context does not say what was taken, list 'intoxicado' under needs_clarification.
sources: OpenExamPrep, CCHI Certified Healthcare Interpreter study guide, 'Abbreviations, Eponyms, False Cognates & Terminology Management' (open-exam-prep.com/study-guides/cchi-chi/terminology-word-structure/abbreviations-eponyms-false-cognates-terminology-management)
